plan.title: Upload attachment to saved eRFX draft

steps.note: Start creating the saved eRFX draft.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required tenant configuration for vendor addition during event creation.
Apply the required tenant configuration for stage addition.
Apply a pricing template so the draft can contain line items.
Add the required line item to make the draft valid.
Complete the pricing sheet before saving the draft.
Commit a valid schedule for the draft.
Create the saved, unpublished eRFX draft used by the attachment scenario.
Navigate to the Events list to locate the saved draft.
Open the Drafts tab specified by the case.
Confirm the newly saved draft is listed before opening it.
Open the draft's attachment upload window.

args.goal: in the Upload Attachments window, drag and drop the provided valid_document.pdf file (2 MB, under 20 MB) onto the area labeled "Click or drag file to this area to upload", click Save, and stop when the eRFX draft shows the uploaded file in its attachments section

steps.note: Perform the required drag-and-drop upload and save operation.
Verify that saving the upload closes the window.
Verify that the uploaded file is listed in the draft attachments section.
